promptZh: 志工可以領走哪一塊展板？

options.text: One with a title on the front but no number on the back.
options.zh: 正面有標題、背面沒有編號的展板。
options.whyZh: 即使已有正面標題，沒有背面編號也不能領走。

options.text: One with a number on the back but no title on the front.
options.zh: 背面有編號、正面沒有標題的展板。
options.whyZh: 領取憑背面編號；正面標題不代表是否備妥，也不是領取條件。

options.text: One with a number on the front but nothing on the back.
options.zh: 正面有編號、背面空白的展板。
options.whyZh: 規則指定看背面編號，印在正面的編號不算。

options.text: One with no number on the back but a handle already attached.
options.zh: 背面沒有編號、但已裝上把手的展板。
options.whyZh: 把手用來扶正，不是領取標記；背面仍須有編號。

explanationZh: 領取憑背面編號；正面標題不代表是否備妥，也不是領取條件。
evidence: For Thursday's exhibit pickup, take only panels with a number on the back. / A title on the front doesn't show they're ready; some were printed early.
